availability_audit: Chronology: the Lavaridge Gym sits at the end of the cap-36 window (C22 Mt. Chimney set the cap, C23 is Flannery). Every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Route 102/103/104 (C02-C05), Dewford (C10-C14), Mauville Game Corner and Route 117 (C18-C20), Altering Cave rock-smash with the C18 Rock Smash license. No Surf-gated water (Surf is C27), no Strength-gated area (Strength is granted only after Flannery), no legendary, no post-badge source. All evolution levels are at or below cap 36. Cap-42 re-check for this rerun: window moved 36 -> 42 (FLAG_BADGE04_GET), the window the plan targets ('Medium cap40 levels 43/40/39/40/40/40' = 42 + offset - 2). No member changed, so every source is still a gate<=36 map preceding Lavaridge in book play order. Chronology-legal gate-42 species (Skarmory Route113, Turtonator JaggedPass, Drampa MeteorFalls_1F_1R) were available and not used; the Surf-gated Meteor Falls rooms are not legal here (Surf is C27).
plan: Rebuilt rain team after attempt 1 lost 6-5. Attempt 1 failed because Pelipper carried only 4 SpA EVs and could not convert the rain into damage, and because Choice Band Reckless Wild Charge from Emboar one-shot Assault Vest Azumarill and threatened 4x on Gyarados. v2 keeps Drizzle but makes the rain pay: Swift Swim Kingdra outspeeds the whole room under rain, Pelipper is now a real special attacker, Swampert and Kingdra are Electric-immune or Electric-neutral, Primarina's Fairy typing resists both Fighting and Dark, and Togekiss keeps the redirection. MIST RERUN: this is the room the rerun exists for. Keegan's whole opening is mist-dependent and was invisible in the mist-less run - Hitmontop's Misty Seed cannot activate without terrain, and Flareon's Toxic Orb could poison it immediately on turn 1 with nothing to stop it. With the mist authored, the authored chain should be: Misty Seed activates on Hitmontop's send-out for a one-time Sp.Def boost; Ice Spinner removes the terrain; and only then does Flareon's Toxic Orb trigger at the end of that turn and switch Guts on. I am deliberately NOT trying to remove Hitmontop before it can act - the point of this run is to see whether the chain fires - but I am not throwing either: the plan is to pressure Flareon (which is the payoff half) while letting Hitmontop demonstrate the setup. Until Ice Spinner lands, my grounded Swampert, Kingdra, Primarina and Garganacl are immune to Typhlosion's Burning Jealousy burn, Magmortar's Flame Body and any other new status; airborne Pelipper and Togekiss are not. Kingdra's Dragon Pulse would be mist-halved against grounded targets but Keegan fields no Dragon, so it is dead weight here and I will lead on Hydro Pump and Ice Beam.
